description: Straight answers about moving into pharmaceutical sales, choosing a Pharma Coach program, and keeping applications and enrollment on Med Rep College.

faqs: Can I move into pharmaceutical sales without pharma experience?

Some employers hire candidates from sales, healthcare, education, and other client-facing backgrounds. The work is to translate that experience into evidence that fits the role; each employer still sets its own requirements.
Why am I applying but not getting interviews?

Your target roles, resume, or networking may not make the fit clear. More applications do not fix weak positioning. Start by checking whether the role fits your background and whether your materials show relevant results.
Can I do the program while working full time?
The self-paced material is designed for working professionals, but live coaching and application work still require time. Review the current schedule and access period before enrolling.
What is the difference between Fast Track, Mastermind, and VIP?

Fast Track is self-paced. Mastermind adds live coaching and accountability. VIP adds the most personalized, one-to-one support. Current inclusions, availability, and terms are listed on each enrollment page.
Does coaching guarantee a job or a particular salary?
No. Employers control hiring and compensation, and results depend on the role, market, experience, and execution. Read all written program and refund terms before paying.
Where do I apply for coaching?
The application form remains on Med Rep College so the existing intake workflow keeps working. The new site explains the programs; the legacy system continues to collect the application.
Where do I get the free interview guide?
The guide opt-in remains on Med Rep College so the existing email and delivery workflow stays intact.
Should I schedule a call before choosing a program?
A discovery call can help you discuss fit and next steps before choosing support. Confirm the current price, duration, and cancellation terms on the booking page.
